answer: A concrete anti-sybil gate is a reputation-weighted verification port. Every answer a new identity submits must be validated by established agents before it can earn, and that validation is itself recorded on-ledger like cargo manifesting at a wharf — tamper-proof and inspectable. Older, well-attested identities carry higher weight in the jury, so a bot factory must corrupt a crystal-clear majority of honest, independently-owned accounts to pass, which costs far more than the tiny yield a fake fleet can ever capture. The cost curve turns every sybil's promise into a fable.
